title: Complete tailoring app by wiring offline-first UI to real backend persistence and sync

requirements.text: Replace the current simulated sync engine with real synchronization between locally-stored orders (offline-first) and the Motoko backend so that when connectivity returns, locally created/edited/deleted orders are pushed to the backend and the UI reflects successful sync (or errors) without losing offline functionality.

quotes: Tailor app pura banao uske baad ise karenge

acceptanceCriteria: When the device is offline, the admin can still create, edit, and delete orders and changes are persisted locally.
When the device transitions from offline to online, the app automatically attempts a real sync (not a simulated timeout) and updates the sync indicator accordingly.
After a successful sync, orders created/updated/deleted while offline are persisted in the backend and are still present after a full page refresh / app restart while online.
If backend sync fails (e.g., unauthorized, transient failure), the UI shows an error sync state and local data remains intact (no data loss).

requirements.text: Ensure the Motoko backend exposes and persists the complete set of CRUD operations required by the current Orders list + Order editor UI, and ensure the frontend uses these backend APIs when online (while still using local storage as the offline source of truth).

quotes: Tailor app pura banao uske baad ise karenge

acceptanceCriteria: Backend supports create/list/get/update/delete for orders needed by the UI, protected by admin authorization.
Frontend can load existing orders from the backend when online and authorized, and merges them into local storage without duplicating records.
Admin-only access is enforced for all backend order operations; non-admin callers cannot read or mutate orders.

requirements.text: Keep the tailoring app scope focused by deferring all Jarvis/voice-assistant features until after the tailoring app is complete; do not add voice wake words, calling, music playback, WhatsApp automation beyond the existing order-ready WhatsApp message flow, or flirty/funny assistant behavior in this iteration.

quotes: Tailor app pura banao uske baad ise karenge

acceptanceCriteria: No new voice-assistant or "Hello John" wake-word functionality is introduced in the tailoring app.
No new non-tailoring features are added beyond completing the existing tailoring workflows and persistence/sync.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor with all logic in backend/main.mo; add backend/migration.mo only if an upgrade requires state migration.
Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui or any frontend immutablePaths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT; compose those components instead.
Use English for any user-facing text added as part of this build request.
nonGoals: Building a Jarvis-style voice assistant app or implementing voice command recognition/execution.
Adding third-party authentication providers beyond Internet Identity.
Adding real-time messaging/chat, push notifications, or external databases.

preferencesToAdd: Use English for user-facing text in build specs and any new UI copy added during this iteration.
